privacy.privacyPolicy: Threads, settings, memory, and downloaded models are stored locally. Connected services receive data only when you choose to use them.
privacy.promise1: Local model requests and local workspace data stay on your device
privacy.promise2: Cloud providers receive prompts, context, and attachments needed for the requests you send
privacy.promise3: Local or remote MCP servers receive the tool inputs and context needed for approved tool calls
privacy.promise4: AX Studio does not include product analytics or conversation telemetry
privacy.aiDisclosure: AX Studio displays live AI-generated content. Outputs may be inaccurate or inappropriate; review them before relying on them.
